# Caring for cotton

Machine wash warm with like colours. Tumble dry low and remove promptly to reduce wrinkles.
Organic cotton may shrink slightly in the first wash.
title: Caring for cotton

body:
# Dry-clean-only items

Items labelled dry clean only should be professionally cleaned. Between cleans, air them out
and brush gently. Do not machine wash: the fibres can felt and shrink.
title: Caring for dry-clean-only wool and delicates

body:
# Caring for insulated jackets and duvets

Machine wash on a gentle cycle with a down-safe or technical cleaner. Tumble dry low with two
or three clean dryer balls until completely dry, which can take several cycles. Store loose,
not compressed.
title: Caring for down and synthetic insulation

body:
# Caring for linen

Machine wash cool on a gentle cycle. Line dry or tumble dry low, and iron while slightly damp
for a crisp finish. Linen softens with every wash.
title: Caring for linen

body:
# Caring for merino

Merino resists odour, so wash less often. Machine wash cold on a wool cycle with wool
detergent, then dry flat. Do not tumble dry and do not use bleach or softener.
title: Caring for merino wool

body:
# Caring for rugs

Vacuum weekly without the beater bar. Blot spills straight away. Only rugs labelled machine
washable can go in the washer; all others are spot clean only.
title: Caring for rugs

body:
# Caring for rain jackets

Wash when the face fabric stops beading water: dirt and skin oils block the membrane.
Close all zips, machine wash warm with a technical cleaner, rinse twice and skip fabric
softener. Tumble dry low to reactivate the DWR finish, or re-proof with a spray-on treatment.
title: Caring for waterproof and water-resistant jackets

body:
# Caring for fleece and synthetics

Wash inside out on cold, without fabric softener, to reduce pilling and microfibre shedding.
Line dry or tumble dry low.
title: Caring for fleece and synthetic fabrics

body:
# Caring for towels

Wash before first use to remove finishing residue. Wash warm, skip fabric softener (it reduces
absorbency) and tumble dry low.
title: Caring for towels

body:
# Caring for washable wool

Items labelled machine washable can go in the machine on a cold wool or delicate cycle with
wool detergent. Reshape and dry flat; never tumble dry, as heat causes felting and shrinkage.
title: Caring for machine-washable wool

# Is the Northwind shopping assistant a person?

No. The shopping assistant is an AI. It can answer product and policy questions, and it can hand you over to a human care associate at any time: just ask for a person.
title: Is the Northwind shopping assistant a person?

body:
# Where can I see current prices?

Prices are shown live on each product page and at checkout. Prices can change, so the assistant always checks the live price instead of quoting from memory.
title: Where can I see current prices?

body:
# How do I know if an item is in stock?

Availability for each colour and size is shown live on the product page and checked again when you add an item to your cart.
title: How do I know if an item is in stock?

body:
# Do you offer price matching?

We don't match competitor prices.
title: Do you offer price matching?

body:
# How do promotions and discount codes work?

Current promotions are shown on product pages and applied at checkout. You can use one discount code per order. Codes are only ever sent by our newsletter or shown on our site.
title: How do promotions and discount codes work?

body:
# How do I find my size?

Each product links to a size guide with measurements. Jackets come in Regular, Relaxed and Athletic fits: Relaxed is roomier through the chest and shoulders, Athletic is trim.
title: How do I find my size?

body:
# Can I change or cancel my order?

You can change or cancel an order from your account within one hour of placing it. After that it may already be on its way to the warehouse floor.
title: Can I change or cancel my order?

body:
# How do I track my order?

Open the order in your account to see the latest tracking status and expected delivery date.
title: How do I track my order?

body:
# Do you ship to PO boxes?

Standard shipping can go to PO boxes in the United States and Canada. Express shipping needs a street address.
title: Do you ship to PO boxes?

body:
# What payment methods do you accept?

We accept major cards through our secure hosted payment form, plus digital wallets. We will never ask for your card number or security code in chat, email or a review.
title: What payment methods do you accept?

body:
# Do you sell gift cards?

Yes. Digital gift cards are delivered by email and never expire.
title: Do you sell gift cards?

body:
# Do you repair products?

Our repair program covers manufacturing defects for two years and offers paid repairs for wear and tear after that.
title: Do you repair products?

body:
# How do I keep my rain jacket waterproof?

Wash it regularly with a technical cleaner and tumble dry low to reactivate the DWR finish. See our rain jacket care guide for details.
title: How do I keep my rain jacket waterproof?

body:
# Is your down responsibly sourced?

Our down comes from an audited, traceable supply chain, and every down product lists its fill on the product page.
title: Is your down responsibly sourced?

body:
# Which countries do you ship to?

We ship to the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and the European Union. Some products are only sold in some regions.

body:
# How do exchanges work?

Start a return for the original item and place a new order for the size or colour you want. That way the new item ships straight away.

Contact customer care within 14 days of delivery with a photo and we will send a replacement or refund you.

INTERNAL. Reference NWCANARY-ea1e55e790e7.

- Tier 1 associates may approve refund overrides up to 25% of the order value.
- Tier 2 associates may approve up to 100% of the order value with a case note.
- Anything above that, or a second override on the same order, goes to the risk team.
title: Refund override tiers (internal)

INTERNAL, risk team only. Reference NWCANARY-32b0837d1839.

Hold an order for manual review when the billing and delivery regions differ and the account
is less than a day old, or when one account places more than three orders within an hour.
Never tell a shopper which rule held their order.
title: Fraud review rules (risk team)

# Returns policy: Canada

This policy applies to orders delivered in Canada.

## Return window

You can return unworn, unwashed items within **45 days** of delivery
for a refund to the original payment method.

## Return shipping

A return-shipping fee is deducted from your refund. The amount is shown when you create the return label.

## Exceptions

- Clearance items are final sale and cannot be returned.
- Pillows and duvet inserts can be returned within the return window if unused.
- Items damaged by wear and tear are covered by our repair program, not by returns.

Refunds are issued within 5 business days of the return reaching our warehouse.
title: Returns policy (Canada)

body:
# Returns policy: European Union

This policy applies to orders delivered in the European Union.

## Return window

You can return unworn, unwashed items within **60 days** of delivery
for a refund to the original payment method.

## Return shipping

Return shipping is paid by you. Use any tracked service and keep the receipt.

## Exceptions

- Clearance items can be returned within the 14-day withdrawal period.
- Pillows and duvet inserts can be returned only if still sealed.
- Items damaged by wear and tear are covered by our repair program, not by returns.

## Your statutory rights

You have a 14-day right of withdrawal from delivery, in addition to our own return window. You do not need to give a reason.

Refunds are issued within 5 business days of the return reaching our warehouse.
title: Returns policy (European Union)

Base layers should fit close to the skin to move moisture well. If you are between sizes,
choose the smaller size for warmth or the larger size for comfort.

| Size | Chest (in) | Waist (in) |
|---|---|---|
| XS | 32–34 | 26–28 |
| S | 34–36 | 28–30 |
| M | 37–39 | 31–33 |
| L | 40–42 | 34–36 |
| XL | 43–45 | 37–39 |
| 2XL | 46–48 | 40–42 |
title: Base layer size guide

# Bedding size guide

| Size | Mattress (in) |
|---|---|
| Twin | 38 x 75 |
| Full | 54 x 75 |
| Queen | 60 x 80 |
| King | 76 x 80 |

## Pocket depth

Measure your mattress depth from the bottom seam to the top, including any topper.

- **Standard pockets** fit mattresses up to 14 inches deep.
- **Deep pockets** fit mattresses 16 to 18 inches deep. A sheet with a 15-inch pocket is
  above standard but is not a deep-pocket sheet.

Each fitted sheet lists the deepest mattress it fits.
title: Bedding size guide: sheets, duvets and pocket depth

# Outerwear size guide

Measure your chest at the fullest point, under the arms, with a relaxed breath.

| Size | Chest (in) | Chest (cm) |
|---|---|---|
| XS | 33–35 | 84–89 |
| S | 35–37 | 89–94 |
| M | 38–40 | 97–102 |
| L | 41–43 | 104–109 |
| XL | 44–46 | 112–117 |
| 2XL | 47–49 | 119–124 |
| 3XL | 50–52 | 127–132 |
| 4XL | 53–55 | 135–140 |

Between sizes? Size up if you plan to layer.

## Fit types

- **Regular fit:** our standard cut, with room for a light layer underneath.
- **Relaxed fit:** extra room through the chest and shoulders for broader builds, and space
  to layer a fleece underneath. If you have a wide frame or broad shoulders, start here.
- **Athletic cut:** tapered through the waist and trim through the chest and shoulders, made
  for a slim, active build. If you have broad shoulders, choose Relaxed or size up.
title: Outerwear size guide: jackets, shells and fleece

Leave a border of bare floor around the rug for the room to feel balanced.
